canon.world_bible_summary:
SERVER_ROOM: damp concrete, exposed brick (dim LED rack glow, deep shadows)
NEO_ACCRA: gleaming biodomes, engineered vines (solar lattice glow, soft ambient light)
NEO_NAIROBI: glass corridors, ancient stone foundations (natural light, deep shadows)
NEO_BEIJING: exposed machinery, quantum relay towers (neon glow, flickering holographic lights)
NEO_JAIPUR: pink sandstone facades, quantum display panels (holographic glow, soft ambient light)
NEO_NEW_YORK: glass-and-steel towers, hover-racing circuit (bright LED lights, fast-paced neon glow)
NEO_MEXICO_CITY: medical equipment, anti-grav supports (sterile white light, soft ambient glow)
NEO_CAIRO: sand-white towers, solar sails (warm desert light, soft shadows)
NEO_ROME: Renaissance marble, quantum-glass display panels (soft natural light, warm glow)
SWISS_SKY_RAILWAY: suspended mountain rail, floating plateaus (soft cloud light, distant snow peaks)
NEO_KYOTO: ancient bamboo sanctuaries, climate domes (soft lantern light, engineered silence)
CARTOGRAPHER_SANCTUARY: ancient stone, sacred geometry (soft candlelight, contemplative ambiance)
VAULT_OF_HUMANITY: ancient artifacts, knowledge repositories (soft glow, reverent ambiance)
